en: Black‑and‑white coastal scene showing a rocky shoreline with a sheltered bay. In the foreground are two small wooden cottages with steep, tiled roofs typical of Scandinavian seaside houses. A dirt path winds along the shore where people stroll in light summer clothing. On the right side of the bay stands a long row of upright stone slabs or boulders arranged in a line, resembling a megalithic or memorial site. Several sailboats are moored in the calm water, and barren rock islands and outcrops form the background under a clear sky. The overall composition looks like a scenic tourist photograph printed as a postcard.
